ia.prompt: Keep the same 9 tiles, in this order: 1) spins_s: a colorful prize wheel on a golden stand on a tile of the same color as the draft, 2) spins_l: a colorful prize wheel with sparkles and gold coins flying around on a tile of the same color as the draft, 3) starter: a gift box bursting open with green cash, a blue gem and a yellow lightning bolt popping out on a tile of the same color as the draft, 4) offline2x: a red alarm clock with a yellow crescent moon and little stars on a tile of the same color as the draft, 5) finish_merge: a green upward arrow with a blue ball and a pink ball merging into a golden ball, with a small clock on a tile of the same color as the draft, 6) grow_all: a green sprout in a mound of soil with a small red alarm clock and sparkles on a tile of the same color as the draft, 7) revive: a big glossy red heart with small white wings on a tile of the same color as the draft, 8) egg_x3: three blue spotted eggs side by side on a tile of the same color as the draft, 9) egg_x8: a pile of eight colorful spotted eggs on a tile of the same color as the draft.
